NLow.symptoms: Pale yellowing of older leaves (chlorosis), stunted vegetative growth, low protein content.
NLow.chemical_fertilizer: Urea (46% N) at 50-75 kg/hectare or Ammonium Nitrate.
NLow.organic_alternative: Apply well-decomposed Farmyard Manure (FYM), Neem cake, blood meal, or composted poultry manure.
NLow.action_advice: Split nitrogen application into basal dose and top dressing during active vegetative growth phase for maximum uptake.

NHigh.symptoms: Excessive dark green leafy growth, delayed flowering and fruiting, weak stems susceptible to lodging and pests.
NHigh.chemical_fertilizer: Avoid adding any nitrogenous fertilizers. Apply single superphosphate (SSP) or potash to balance nutrient ratio.
NHigh.organic_alternative: Incorporate sawdust, dried straw, or high-carbon mulches to immobilize excess soluble nitrogen.
NHigh.action_advice: Flush soil with measured irrigation if well-draining, and delay top-dressing until vegetative excess balances out.

PLow.symptoms: Purplish or reddish discoloration on leaves and stems, poor root development, delayed maturity.
PLow.chemical_fertilizer: Diammonium Phosphate (DAP 18:46:0) or Single Super Phosphate (SSP 16% P2O5).
PLow.organic_alternative: Apply Bone meal, rock phosphate, or mycorrhizal biofertilizers to improve phosphorus solubility.
PLow.action_advice: Incorporate phosphorus near the root zone during sowing/transplanting as phosphorus is relatively immobile in soil.

PHigh.symptoms: Interferes with the uptake of micronutrients like Zinc and Iron, causing secondary deficiencies.
PHigh.chemical_fertilizer: Discontinue all phosphorus and DAP fertilizers. Apply Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4) foliar spray to counteract Zinc lockout.
PHigh.organic_alternative: Apply humic acid and plain organic compost to buffer high phosphorus toxicity.
PHigh.action_advice: Ensure soil pH is maintained between 6.0 and 7.0 to prevent micronutrient lockups.

KLow.symptoms: Marginal scorching and curling of leaf tips, weak stems, decreased disease resistance, poor fruit size.
KLow.chemical_fertilizer: Muriate of Potash (MOP 60% K2O) or Potassium Sulphate (SOP 50% K2O).
KLow.organic_alternative: Wood ash, kelp meal, greensand, or banana peel compost.
KLow.action_advice: Apply potassium in two split applications: at planting and during fruit/grain filling stage.

KHigh.symptoms: Inhibits uptake of Magnesium and Calcium, leading to blossom end rot or interveinal chlorosis.
KHigh.chemical_fertilizer: Withhold potash fertilizers. Apply Magnesium Sulphate (Epsom salt) or gypsum (Calcium Sulphate).
KHigh.organic_alternative: Irrigate deeply to leach excess potassium salts from root zone.
KHigh.action_advice: Check soil electrical conductivity (EC) and balance with balanced calcium/magnesium soil amendments.

Balanced.symptoms: Vibrant healthy green foliage, vigorous root system, optimal flowering and yield potential.
Balanced.chemical_fertilizer: Maintain maintenance dose with balanced N-P-K (19:19:19 or 20:20:20) water-soluble fertilizer.
Balanced.action_advice: Continue regular soil health monitoring and follow recommended crop rotation practices.
